frontMatter.title: Thursday Club Night: Cup Badminton at Claremont Stadium
frontMatter.summary: Join us for Thursday Club Night at Claremont Stadium—Grade 4 Mens Cup match (Navan v WSBC) plus 2 courts available for members.

prev.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium: Match Night, Two Courts & Juvenile Club
prev.summary: Monday Club Night is back in Claremont Stadium with Grade 7 Mens (Navan ‘B’ vs Drumree), two adult courts from 8:30pm, and Juvenile Club sessions for girls (6:30pm) and boys (7:30pm).

next.title: Club Update: League Final Bound & Cup Wins
next.summary: A week of mixed results: playoff exits for Grade 4 Mixed and Grade 3 Mixed, three Cup wins on the bounce, and Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ reach the League Final vs Kildalkey on Tuesday 10th March in Wilkinstown. No Club Night this Wednesday due to MBA Mixed League Finals.
